behavior.built_loop: Original planting complete -> E collect water at barrel -> E tend same planter -> persistent care acknowledgement and two additional blooms.
behavior.persistence: One additive CareComplete bool in existing version1 SG/slot, saved before local success; carried water session-only; failed save retains water and old completion state.

composition.kiosk_overlap_fix: Barrel moved within owned care grouping to separate its2.4m input radius from kiosk; no input priority framework.

unreal.note: Build one owned collect-water/tend-flower step using existing E/UI/garden SaveGame. No rewards/reset/new timers/framework/Play loops.

persistence_boundaries.HasWater: Session-only, unlimited recollection, no inventory token/cost.
persistence_boundaries.save_failure: Local success/blooms are withheld; water stays carried for retry. On-disk failure transactionality is not claimed.
persistence_boundaries.legacy_save_compatibility: Intended additive missing-field default; not exercised against old player files in this build-only pass.

limits: Barrel/planter authored behavior only; feeder/compost/crate stay decorative.
No rewards, original planting reset, new timer, inventory or economy framework.
Editor view shows normal saved composition, not completed-care runtime HUD/blooms.
